sfxStyle: Isolated single sound effect, close-mic'd and dry, no reverb tail, no music, no voices, no background noise, starts immediately with no silence at the head.

ambience.label: Lake ambience
ambience.use: Loops under everything from the first gesture onward
ambience.text: Calm lake shore ambience: gentle water lapping against pebbles, soft breeze through reeds, faint distant birdsong

throw.label: Throw whoosh
throw.use: The stone leaves the hand; rate and level scale with power
throw.text: A hard overarm throw: sharp swish of an arm cutting through air, close and dry

skip.label: Skip
skip.use: Every bounce of a combo; pitch climbs a semitone each skip
skip.text: A flat stone skipping once off calm water: crisp wet plink with a light tick of spray

settle.label: Settle
settle.use: The stone runs out of speed and lies down in the water
settle.text: A small flat stone losing speed and settling into calm water, soft rounded plop

sink.label: Sink
sink.use: The stone goes under for good
sink.text: A stone sinking into deep water: deep muffled glub followed by rising bubbles

blast.label: Splash blast
blast.text: A violent water splash explosion, heavy impact and a wide burst of spray

boing.label: Rubber rebound
boing.use: Springy hull bounce; rate climbs with the bounce count
boing.text: A springy rubber rebound, taut cartoon boing with a wet edge to it

thunk.label: Hull thunk
thunk.text: A heavy stone striking a hollow wooden boat hull, loud solid wooden thud, close and blunt

knockwood.label: Bridge knock
knockwood.use: Clipping the underside of a bridge deck
knockwood.text: A hard knock against thick hollow wooden planks, loud blunt timber thud with a short woody ring

knockstone.label: Cave knock
knockstone.use: Clipping a cave roof — the stone version of the bridge knock
knockstone.text: A stone striking the rock roof of a cave, dull deep stone knock answered by a short cave echo

paddle.label: Mill paddle
paddle.use: A watermill paddle catches the stone
paddle.text: A wet wooden watermill paddle slapping a stone away, heavy timber slap over a groaning axle

plunge.label: Waterfall plunge
plunge.use: Going over a lip; deeper drops play slower
plunge.text: A stone carried over a waterfall lip: rushing water then a heavy plunge into the pool below

iceslide.label: Ice slide
iceslide.use: Landing on a frozen sheet; faster arrivals hiss higher
iceslide.text: A stone sliding fast across a frozen lake: long bright hiss with the ringing whistle of ice under it

weeds.label: Weed drag
weeds.text: A stone ploughing into wet lake reeds, sodden rustling drag slowing to a stop

deck.label: Deck landing
deck.use: The stone lands ON a boat rather than hitting it
deck.text: A stone landing flat on a wooden boat deck, wooden clatter settling to rest

reel.label: Reel tick
reel.use: Fishing reel ratchet — fires rapidly, so it stays quiet
reel.text: One click of a fishing reel ratchet, tiny dry tick

catch.label: Catch
catch.text: Bright cheerful reward chime, two clear bell notes ringing out loud and clean, video game item pickup

fishmiss.label: Fish miss
fishmiss.text: Short soft descending failure blip, dull and deflated, video game UI

pip.label: UI pip
pip.use: Every button in the game; by far the most-fired cue
pip.text: Soft short UI click blip, clean and bright, video game menu tick

light.label: Start light
light.use: The tee light changing to red, then orange; pitch climbs with the count
light.text: Single short electronic beep of a race start light, clean square tone

go.label: Green light
go.text: Sport commentator saying "GO" with enthusiams. Smash brawl style

grind.label: Shaping grind
grind.use: Grinding a stone into shape; fires repeatedly while dragging
grind.text: Short rasping scrape of stone against a grinding wheel

clank.label: Core clank
clank.use: The drill hits the dense heart of a stone
clank.text: Hard bright metallic ping of a drill bit striking dense stone

paint.label: Paint dab
paint.use: Painting a stone; fires repeatedly while dragging
paint.text: Soft wet brush dab against stone, one short paint stroke

pick.label: Pick up rock
pick.use: Lifting a stone off the bench or the shore
pick.text: Picking a pebble out of gravel, dry stone clack

gull.label: Gull
gull.use: Fires on its own every 7-19s as lake colour
gull.text: A single distant seagull cry over open water, far away and thin

holewin.label: Hole won
holewin.text: Short triumphant fanfare, four rising notes, cheerful and bright, video game round won

holelose.label: Hole lost
holelose.text: Short neutral three-note jingle, mildly deflated, video game round lost

win.label: Victory
win.text: Triumphant victory fanfare, rising notes resolving into a warm major chord, celebratory video game win

lose.label: Defeat
lose.text: Descending four-note failure jingle, glum and final, video game over

splashed.label: Splashed
splashed.text: Comic drenching: a bucket of lake water thrown over someone, wet slap and dribble

menu.label: Menu
menu.use: Title screen and the bench; loops
menu.prompt: Warm unhurried acoustic folk instrumental for a lakeside game menu. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft upright bass, brushed snare, gentle mandolin. Sunny, patient, nostalgic. Steady mid-slow tempo, no build, loops calmly.

play.label: Gameplay
play.prompt: Light rhythmic acoustic instrumental for playful lakeside competition. Plucked guitar and banjo ostinato, hand percussion, warm bass. Bouncy and upbeat but never frantic, sits behind gameplay, steady loop with no dramatic swells.

victory.label: Victory
victory.use: Plays once over the results screen when you win
victory.prompt: Short celebratory acoustic folk flourish. Full band hits, mandolin and fiddle trading a bright triumphant melody, warm brass swell, big satisfying final chord.
